name: Skipping Stones
tagline: Flat stones, a long lake, the perfect angle.
description: A physics arcade game about the oldest good idea at a lake. Drag to set power and aim, release, and watch a flat stone skip away from you while it keeps a little energy for one more bounce. Five lakes with their own light and wind, a hundred generated challenges that each ship with a verified winning throw, a daily stone for everyone, and a collection of stones that genuinely throw differently. No timer, no lives, one more throw.
highlights: 100 journey challenges across five lakes, each proven solvable by a stored throw
Deterministic 3D stone physics: power, launch angle, spin, wind and stone shape all matter
Daily challenge seeded by UTC date so every player gets the same lake
Six stones and six trails, balanced so nothing is pay-to-win
howToPlay: Drag up from the water to set power, slide left or right to aim, then release.
A shallow, fast, spinning stone skips. A steep or tired one goes straight in.
Hit the buoys, make the skip count, and chase your best distance.
levels: 100 journey challenges · 5 lakes + daily, zen, endless, precision and trick shot
